prompt: A prime-time adult animated sitcom background: flat colours and slightly wobbly black outlines, every colour laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Looking straight down from a rooftop into a narrow 1930s American street at night: soot-black brick walls fall away to wet cobbles at the bottom, where a police car's light throws red and blue up the walls. In a puddle on the cobbles, the only sign of the sky: the reflection of a small, perfectly round, solid red moon. One window halfway down glows candle yellow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
